# Publication boundary

- Runtime owner includes retained source notices and all helper/reference resources; review cases/reports stay outside it.
- Publish actual source-projection revision before generating both skill index and coverage.
- Refresh current main and inspect exact delta; preserve all actual material authors and DCO.
- Run noneditable wheel closure before a serial full suite without concurrent checkout/build/writers.
- Require stable-head independent review, exact-head Ready jobs and latest admission success before normal merge/issue closure readback.
- No workflow/rule edit, native claim promotion, unrelated acceptance or managed import.
